Arta AI Sidekick is your always-on investment assistant, analyst, and portfolio aggregator that can power-up your investment insights - all through a simple conversation.

Arta AI Sidekick doesn't trade for you or provide investment advice. It's your partner providing the tools, insights, and analysis to help you make informed decisions on your own terms.

PROFESSIONAL TOOLS, MADE SIMPLE
+ See everything in one place - Track your portfolio across global equities, ETFs, crypto, all aggregated in a unified view. Coming soon - mutual funds, real estate, and private equity

record.name: Muni AI Finance
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Muni is a calmer way to keep track of finances.

Instead of setting up budgets, categories, accounts, and rules before you can begin, just tell Muni what happened. Log expenses, income, savings, debts, bills, reminders, and planned payments in plain language, then review and confirm what Muni understood.

Muni is built for people who want financial awareness but struggle to stay consistent with traditional budgeting apps. It helps you keep a useful money log without turning every purchase into homework.

Muni requires an auto-renewable subscription after the 7-day App Store trial to use money logging, chat, voice notes, insights, reminders, and related app features.

What you can do with Muni while subscribed:

Record expenses and income naturally
Keep a timeline of confirmed money records
Track savings, goals, and interest details
Manage debts you owe or money owed to you
Record debt payments and remaining balances
Add bills, reminders, planned expenses, and recurring costs
Review insights in plain language
Edit inferred details whenever something needs correcting

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Muni is not here to shame you, overwhelm you, or force a perfect budget. It is here to help you notice what is happening with your money, one simple entry at a time.

Tell Muni what happened. Muni handles the log.

Privacy Policy: https://muni.vytapps.com/privacy.html

Meet your personal AI CFO. Fincio tracks every account, scores your financial health, and gives expert money advice through natural conversation. Budget smarter, cut debt faster, and build real wealth — in 160+ currencies.

WHETHER YOU'RE PAYING OFF DEBT, BUILDING AN EMERGENCY FUND, OR GROWING YOUR NET WORTH, FINCIO GIVES YOU THE FINANCIAL CLARITY YOU DESERVE.


YOUR AI CFO — ALWAYS ON CALL

Stop guessing. Your AI CFO knows your full financial picture: every account, the last 90 days of transactions, your goals, and your health score. Ask anything.

- "Am I on track to pay off my credit card by June?"
- "Where did most of my money go last month?"
- "Add groceries $120, coffee $8, gym $50"

Your AI CFO can even log multiple transactions in one message — just say what you spent. No more tedious manual entry.

Free plan: 3 AI conversations per day
Pro plan: Unlimited conversations, deeper analysis

FINANCIAL HEALTH SCORE — KNOW WHERE YOU STAND

Your 0–100 Financial Health Score is calculated from three proven metrics:
- Savings rate
- Debt-to-income ratio
- Emergency fund coverage

Color-coded and updated in real time. Green means you're thriving. Red means your AI CFO has actionable advice waiting.



DASHBOARD — YOUR WEALTH AT A GLANCE

Everything important, in one view:
- Net worth across all your accounts
- 6-month cash flow bar chart (income vs. expenses)
- Debt overview and payoff progress
- Financial goal tracking with progress bars
- AI insight cards surfacing what matters most



FULL ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT

Add and manage every account type:
- Checking and savings
- Credit cards
- Loans and mortgages
- Investments and retirement accounts

Transfer money between accounts with a tap. Your net worth updates instantly.



TRANSACTION TRACKING, YOUR WAY

Log income, expenses, and transfers with full detail. Then find anything fast:
- Filter by date range, category, or account
- Search transactions by merchant or keyword
- Category manager to organize spending your way



REPORTS THAT REVEAL THE FULL PICTURE

Stop wondering where your money goes. Fincio gives you:
- Income vs. expenses over time
- Category spending breakdown
- Monthly trend analysis
- Net worth history chart

See the story behind your numbers, not just the numbers.



BUILT FOR THE ENTIRE WORLD

Fincio is designed for everyone, everywhere:
- 195 countries supported
- 160+ currencies with live-accurate formatting
- Country-aware AI advice (retirement accounts, tax systems, local financial norms)

Whether you earn in USD, GBP, INR, or AED — Fincio speaks your financial language.


FINANCIAL GOALS — PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE

Set goals for anything: emergency fund, holiday, down payment, debt payoff. Visual progress bars and AI coaching keep you motivated and on track.



PRIVACY YOU CAN COUNT ON

Your financial data is yours. Fincio does not sell your data, share it with advertisers, or use it to train AI models. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from within the app.



PREMIUM — FINCIO PRO

Start free with 2 months on us — full Pro access, no charge until your trial ends.

Pro Weekly: $1.99/week
Pro Monthly: $4.99/month
Pro Annual: $49.99/year (save 17%)

Pro includes: Unlimited AI CFO conversations, full reports suite, advanced filtering, and priority access to new features.

Subscriptions are managed through your Apple ID. Cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Payment is charged at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Dominant AI is a multi-agent system designed to help you make better, smarter investment decisions.

Unlike widely used LLM models, Dominant AI is essentially an orchestrator of dozens of specialized AI agents, each performing a specific function and working together within a unified infrastructure. - Real-time financial news analysis
- Analysis of market-moving events
- Investor sentiment analysis
- Analysis of events that specifically impact your investment portfolio
- Identification of potential threats and development of a portfolio protection plan
- Portfolio research
- Building a portfolio from scratch
- Identifying investment opportunities

Discover new opportunities!

Conduct in-depth stock analysis.
Specialized AI agents have access to the latest company reports, current market prices and data, analyst estimates and forecasts. Now you can conduct comprehensive, in-depth research on any company without spending hours doing it yourself.

Build your investment portfolio from scratch with an AI assistant.

You can go from defining your investment objective to recommendations for your portfolio structure and specific selection of assets.

You won't be alone on this journey!
Our community of investors who invest alongside AI continues to grow. Built around the app, it already includes more than 8,400 individual investors.

You can always count on the support of our community.

Tired of switching between budgeting apps, logging entries by hand, and still not knowing where your money goes?

Meet Rolly, the all-in-one AI finance tracker and monthly budget planner designed to simplify how you manage money, track spending, and save smarter -- all through an intuitive AI chat.

Whether you are a working professional or managing multiple income streams, Rolly makes money management effortless and fun. Just snap receipts, use your voice, or log expenses through chat. Rolly is the only budgeting app you will ever need.

WHY CHOOSE ROLLY?

Managing money should not feel like a chore. While most budgeting apps just track numbers, Rolly does more -- it talks to you and adapts to your style. Feeling spendy? Let Rolly's Angry Mom personality call you out. Need a push to save? Switch to Wise Friend for practical advice.

TRACK EXPENSES YOUR WAY

- Chat to Track: Type "Coffee 15, Movie 5" and Rolly instantly logs them under the right categories. No dropdowns, no forms.
- Speak to Log: Use voice input to record expenses hands-free.
- Scan Receipts: Snap and upload receipts. Rolly auto-logs each item as a separate transaction in the correct category.
- AI Categorization: Every transaction is instantly sorted with pinpoint accuracy.

POWERFUL MONEY MANAGEMENT

- Smart Budgets: Create monthly budgets with AI-generated suggestions based on your spending patterns.
- Savings Goals: Set targets, visualize progress, and reach financial milestones faster.
- Debt Tracking: Monitor and manage all your debts with clear payoff timelines.
- Multiple Wallets: Separate work, travel, family, and personal spending.
- Shared Wallets: Collaborate with friends or family on group budgets and recurring transactions.
- Bank Connections: Link your bank accounts for automatic transaction imports.

STAY MOTIVATED

- Financial Challenges: Challenge friends to saving or spending goals. Make budgeting social and fun.
- AI Personalities: Switch between sassy, wise, or strict -- Rolly adapts to your vibe and keeps you accountable.
- Analytics Dashboard: Beautiful charts, spending insights, milestones, and calendar views.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE

- Multi-Currency Support: Track finances in any currency, perfect for travelers and expats.
- 9 Languages: Available in English, Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, and French.
- Import & Export: Bring your data from other apps or export for your records.
- Recurring Transactions: Set up automatic tracking for subscriptions and regular bills.

From coffee runs to car payments, Rolly is your trusted spending tracker, expense manager, money saving tracker, payment tracker, and all-in-one finance companion.

If you have tried money managing apps that overcomplicate things, switch to a smarter, simpler, and more supportive budgeting app. With Rolly, you will spend better, save faster, and finally feel in control of your money.

Start your journey to financial clarity today.

JOURNAL YOUR TRADES. UNDERSTAND YOUR HABITS.

AI ADVISOR AND WEEKLY COACHING
Ask the AI Advisor about a chart, market context or trading discipline. AI can make mistakes; check its output before acting.

CONNECT YOUR ACCOUNTS
View supported MT4/MT5 account balances, equity, positions and history with Elite. Automatic imports help bring closed trades into your journal. Supported Binance, Bybit and IBKR connections are available across plans. Connections are read-only; TIC does not place broker orders. Import coverage and availability vary by provider.

PRACTISE AND REPLAY
Use paper trading and a virtual portfolio to practise without placing real-money trades. Join the Trading League or use Elite's Backtest Lab to replay historical charts and work through decisions candle by candle. Simulated results are not actual investment returns.

DISCUSS SETUPS WITH OTHER TRADERS
Pro and Elite members can join the discussion room, share chart images, ask questions, react and reply in threads. Stay involved with reply and TIC Team notifications according to your settings. Discuss individual trade ideas and join “Ask Ahmed” every Sunday. Free members can preview conversations.

YOUR DAILY MARKET WORKSPACE
Follow watchlists, price alerts, charts, market sentiment, the economic calendar and market sessions. Explore market analysis, price scenarios and confidence breakdowns where available. Trade ideas include timeframes, reasoning, opposing factors, entry, stop and three targets. TIC Desk brings your tools together on mobile and desktop, with access based on your plan.

RISK, CAPITAL AND DISCIPLINE
Use position-size, pip, margin and compound-growth calculators. Elite adds capital planning and Prop Guardrails to help monitor configured daily-loss and drawdown limits using available account data. These tools cannot prevent losses or guarantee compliance with a provider's rules.

LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE
Build your knowledge with Trading Academy lessons and quizzes. Learn, practise and review your trading at your own pace.

START FREE. CHOOSE WHAT YOU NEED.
Start with free tools, manual journaling and paper trading. Pro adds AI and journal capabilities plus member discussions. Elite adds weekly coaching, Backtest Lab, Chart Vision, broker account tools and more. record.description_evidence:
Snap a receipt. Expense AI reads it, categorizes it, and files it, in seconds. No spreadsheets. No manual entry. Just a beautifully designed app that finally makes expense tracking effortless.

Whether you're managing personal spending, tracking business receipts, or getting your finances properly organized for the first time, Expense AI does the heavy lifting.

----------------------
ALL-NEW DESIGN IN V2
----------------------

Expense AI has been completely redesigned. Every screen is faster, more polished, and built around how you actually use the app: fluid animations, a redesigned home screen with live spending charts, and your most important numbers front and center.

----------------------
SCAN & CAPTURE RECEIPTS
----------------------

Take a photo of any receipt and AI automatically extracts the merchant, amount, date, items, and tax. Or forward receipt emails to your personal Expense AI address: the app captures everything without you lifting a finger. Supports photos, PDFs, and email attachments.

----------------------
BUDGETS & SAVINGS GOALS
----------------------

Create budgets by spending category and track usage against your limits in real time with visual charts. Set savings goals with target amounts and deadlines, follow your progress on a timeline, and mark them complete when you get there.

----------------------
FINANCIAL HEALTH & INSIGHTS
----------------------

See beyond the numbers. Expense AI surfaces your spending patterns, income vs. expense trends, and personalized insights about your overall financial wellbeing, so you always know where you stand.

----------------------
IMPORT TRANSACTIONS
----------------------

Already have history elsewhere? Import bank statements and CSV files directly into Expense AI. Review each transaction, edit details inline, and confirm before anything is added.

----------------------
CHAT WITH YOUR FINANCES
----------------------

Ask anything. "How much did I spend on food last month?" "Show me my top merchants this quarter." Expense AI answers instantly, generates reports, and visualizes your data, all from a simple chat.

----------------------
EVERYTHING ELSE
----------------------

• Multi-currency support for international spending
• Share extension: upload receipts from Photos, Files, or any app
• Custom app icons and dark mode
• Export reports as CSV or PDF
• Detailed analytics: top merchants, top products, category breakdown

----------------------
SUBSCRIPTION
----------------------

Free to download. Premium features require a subscription billed to your Apple ID. Subscription renews automatically: manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings.
